# ↪️ Pull Request

Based on https://github.com/parcel-bundler/parcel/pull/3404 by @Drapegnik

Closes #3404, fixes #3362, fixes #235, fixes #301

Overview:
- Add a named pipeline `webmanifest` for webmanifests and the corresponding transformer to collect dependencies
- Cleanup schema validation function parameters (and make it possible to pass an existing json sourcemap)
- Validate the parts of the manifest that we parse and add loc information to the `addURLDependency` call

Change to previous PR:
- Remove special context, use named pipeline instead
- Rename from "pwa-manifest" to "webmanifest"

issue_context.title: Parcel 2: Web Manifest transformer
issue_context.body:
Create the `@parcel/transformer-webmanifest` package in `packages/transforms/webmanifest`. This package is a Parcel 2 transform plugin for web manifests. It should be based on the `WebManifestAsset` from Parcel 1.

The `@parcel/transformer-webmanifest` package is responsible for the following things:

* Parsing JSON
* Collecting dependencies
* Rewriting urls
* Generating JSON

We currently only handle the `.webmanifest` extension, but many people want to be able to use `.json` as well (#235, #1039). In order to support this, we need a way for the HTML transformer to specify that the dependency should be treated as a `webmanifest` file regardless of its actual extension.
